name: CommuteAssistLateForMeeting

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a short driving scene with two navigation moments separated by a 15-minute gap. The driver is running late and checks ETA twice — once at the start and once 15 minutes in. Keep exchanges short and tense.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City traffic, car interior morning, traffic lights, driving sounds

initial_prompt: Generate a short driving scene. The driver is running late for a meeting. They ask Sigma how long it will take. Sigma gives an ETA. 15 minutes later, the driver checks again — are they going to make it? Two brief exchanges separated by a time skip.

scenario_template.topic: Driver asks Sigma how long to destination — running late
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, how long to the office?' or 'Sigma, will I make it by 9?'

scenario_template.note: No dialogue. Skip 15 minutes. Driver is now closer but still uncertain.

scenario_template.note: One quick question. Sigma gives updated arrival time. Driver reacts briefly.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives precise ETA in one sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Driver is stressed — speech is short and direct.
The 15-minute gap must feel real in the second exchange.
Sigma gives precise times — '14 minutes', '9:07 arrival'.
No reassurance from Sigma, no filler.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma gives exact ETA only. Nothing else.
No 'don't worry', no 'you should make it'. Just numbers.
